title: Weather
description: The temperature now in the menu bar; click it for feels like, high and low, rain chance, wind, the next hours and the next 7 days. Free data from Open-Meteo, no account or key.
examples: The menu bar shows ☀️ 24°: click it for the next six hours and the week ahead
Type weather: now, the next hours and 7 days in one view; Cmd+K refreshes it

preferences.name: city
preferences.title: City
preferences.description: A city name, with its country after a comma when the name is common (Valletta, or Paris, France). Empty: the city of your Mac's time zone, so no location permission is asked.

preferences.name: units
preferences.title: Units
preferences.description: Temperature, and wind in km/h or mph.
